south-pacific-west-2015.notes: Source 1 is the general South Pacific site captured March 2017; the earlier reader counted 36 rows on source 2, I count 35 teams plus a summary row.

sources.evidence: Crawl of the South Pacific Region site holding 2015 pages including 'Contests 2015', '2015 Western Divisional Contest' and '2015 Problem Sets', though the seed page is a 2003 champions page.
Page headed Western Division Scoreboard, Final Standings, with 35 team rows, columns rank, team, score, A to K, and 'Last Update: Sun 23rd August 2015 using DOMjudge'.
Table of 33 teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, headed ACM South Pacific Western Division.
26-page PDF with cover 'South Pacific Region Divisional Round August 22, 2015, Western Division Contest Problems' and problems A to K.
Baekjoon category titled ACM South Pacific Western Division 2015 listing 11 problems A to K, numbers 11071 to 11081.
